en.headline: 14-year-old arrested after child’s bicycle set alight in Kwai Fong Estate
en.dek: Police found the boy nearby with burns to his face and forearm after a security guard extinguished the fire at a podium garden opposite Kwai Shun House late on Tuesday.
body: A 14-year-old boy has been arrested on suspicion of arson after a child’s bicycle was set on fire at a car-park podium garden in Kwai Fong Estate on Tuesday night.

Police received a report at about 11:19 p.m. that youths had set a bicycle alight opposite Kwai Shun House. A security guard put out the fire and called police. Firefighters found the cause suspicious and referred the case.

Officers later found a 14-year-old boy nearby with injuries to his face and forearm. Initial investigations suggest he accidentally burned himself when a flash fire occurred while a gas canister and lighter were used to set the bicycle alight. He was arrested and is being detained. The Kwai Tsing police district crime investigation team is following up and searching for another youth involved.
The boy was conscious and taken to Princess Margaret Hospital. Scene photos showed a severely burned bicycle, scorch marks, a cleaver, a gas canister and a lighter.

zh.headline: 葵芳邨小童單車遭縱火 14歲少年面部及前臂燒傷被捕
zh.dek: 周二晚上約11時19分，葵信樓對開停車場平台花園有小童單車起火，保安員撲熄後報警，警方其後拘捕一名14歲少年。
body: 葵芳邨停車場平台花園發生縱火案，一名14歲少年涉嫌縱火被捕，面部及前臂受傷。
警方接報，周二晚上約11時19分有青年在葵信樓對開停車場平台花園焚燒一輛小童單車。保安員自行將火救熄並報案。消防人員認為起火原因有可疑，案件轉交警方。
警方在附近發現一名約14歲少年面部及前臂受傷。初步相信有人以氣樽及打火機燃燒單車時發生搶火，意外燒傷自己。他涉嫌縱火被捕，現正被扣留調查。葵青警區刑事調查隊跟進，並追緝另一名涉案青年。
少年清醒，由救護車送往瑪嘉烈醫院治理。現場遺下嚴重燒毀的單車、燒痕、菜刀、氣樽及打火機。
